actions.action: Preserve focus by product identity, not position
actions.mechanism: Retain the focused product control across reordering; use a persistent results heading when that product disappears.
actions.implementation: Key products by ID. Before updating, capture the focused product and control; restore only if disrupted. Never redirect focus from filters.
actions.check: Reorder a retained focused product: the same control stays focused. Remove it: focus reaches the results heading; Tab continues into results.
actions.risk: Replacing nested controls can break otherwise stable product keys.

actions.action: Separate immediate counts from loading and empty states
actions.mechanism: A persistent text summary provides quick counts without treating unfinished requests as zero matches.
actions.implementation: Show “Updating results” during requests. On completion, update the visible count and polite status region; show “No matching products” only for confirmed zero.
actions.check: Within one second of arrival, assert the current count is visible and accessibility-exposed. Verify loading and zero have distinct text.
actions.risk: Screen-reader speech timing varies; rapid announcements may be coalesced.

actions.action: Commit only the newest filter response
actions.mechanism: Versioned requests prevent late responses from restoring obsolete products, counts, or focus destinations.
actions.implementation: Increment a request token per filter change; discard superseded responses. Commit current results, count, and focus reconciliation together, retaining every matching item.
actions.check: Resolve two requests in reverse order. Only the newest changes results or count; test both retained and removed focused products.
actions.risk: Cancellation alone is insufficient; already-completed responses still need token checks.
